purpose: Frozen paired evaluation of evidence-trace assistance: eight fully exposed development regressions and four new-document holdouts, plus one separate Chinese retrieval diagnostic.
ground_truth_origin: All eight previous main questions are exposed development regressions and remain textually unchanged except split metadata. Four new questions were authored from two newly downloaded pinned original public PDFs and checked by an independent agent using PDF text and visual table/mechanism inspection before answer generation. New question/gold content is withheld from production implementers until runtime freeze. This is agent-authored evaluation, not expert/human ground truth.
page_convention: One-based physical PDF pages in the pinned files; do not substitute publication page numbers or newer versions.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
Leveraging Passage Retrieval with Generative Models for Open Domain Question Answering

protocol.baseline: Same frozen code, source bytes, ingestion and model settings; assistance OFF explicitly retains the legacy selector. Report any common pipeline change affecting both arms. Do not substitute a historical run for the paired baseline.
protocol.treatment: Same frozen code and papers with the redesigned facet-coverage evidence-selection assistance ON. No question-specific rules, gold facts or evaluation notes may be consumed by production retrieval.
protocol.generation_settings: Use the same temperature, output cap, provider and endpoint in both arms; record actual returned model ID and all settings.
protocol.context_controls: Start each question from clean equivalent projects/sessions, empty conversation history and no confirmed memories; disable generation-response caches. Warm the parsed/indexed documents identically. Preserve the same source order, source hashes and uploaded bytes.
protocol.trial_order: Alternate or seed-randomize which arm runs first for each paired question. Record order and UTC wall-clock timestamps. Serial execution avoids comparing provider concurrency/load effects with algorithm cost.
protocol.repeats: Exactly one generation per arm per question: twelve primary pairs plus one separate diagnostic pair, twenty-six planned Step-5 provider calls.
protocol.cost_accounting: Use provider usage: prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens and any reasoning/cache details. Time the assistance pass and complete application answer separately. If a field is missing, mark unavailable rather than inferring actual usage from bytes.
protocol.quality_blinding: Random-label packets reveal question, actual answer/source excerpts and original-paper scoring notes, but hide arm, algorithm, usage, timing and traces. Use a different candidate order for the second reviewer. Two independent agent reviewers per main pair; see the separate frozen evaluation protocol.
protocol.critical_activation_report: Report routing decision, whether support items or only gap hints were supplied, added source IDs, assistance bytes and skip/timeout status. Identical prompts or a non-activated algorithm are no-exposure controls, not evidence that the algorithm improved reasoning.
protocol.anti_contamination: Ingest six original pinned PDFs only. No scoring facts, gold text, synthetic chains, question-specific documents or answer-model-preparation outputs may guide implementation. Public papers may be present in model pretraining.
protocol.stop_policy: Do not retry failed paid calls automatically or silently change model/provider. Retain failures and token usage, record the reason, and report the incomplete pair.
protocol.claim_scope: Twelve questions on six related-field papers, only four questions/two papers held out from implementation; one generation per arm. No statistical significance, expert-review, universal memory or deployment-latency claim.
protocol.evaluation_splits: All eight previously tested questions are development_regression. Four new questions on two new documents are new_document_holdout; report the splits separately before pooled results. This is not a pretraining-free or unseen-domain benchmark.
protocol.freeze_policy: First freeze PDF bytes, fixture and this protocol; record file and canonical fixture SHA-256. Freeze runtime code/config and archive them before coordinator reads new-question text/gold or initiates any holdout preparation/generation. Holdout may be ingested and evaluated by the frozen runner. No code, thresholds, gold, questions or split changes in response to holdout outputs. Any subsequent revision is a separate development run and needs a fresh holdout for a new generalization claim.

bounded_run.soft_limit_note: Inherited conservative stop limit, checked between calls; an in-flight call can cross it. If it prevents completion retain all outcomes and report incompleteness, do not silently raise it or rerun.

protocol.retrieval_quality: Before judging the generated answer, assess whether each required fact is fully, partially or not evidenced in that candidate's actual source pack. Require correct subject/attribution, relation and material conditions; a keyword, title, related background or paper-level fact outside the retrieved quotes is not full evidence. Separately flag source labels that contribute neither direct support nor necessary qualifying context. These annotations measure supplied evidence, not answer quality or proven entailment.
protocol.no_extra_answer_model_calls: Do not add generative LLM query expansion, summarization, grading, or repair calls to the product-runtime answer pipeline. Local embedding/reranking/translation costs must still be measured. A claim that ON adds no prompt/total model tokens is an empirical acceptance condition, not an assumption; report actual provider counts and every per-pair increase.

rubric.scale: Each dimension is scored 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4. Weighted total is sum(weight * score / 4), from 0 to 100.

dimensions.description: Method, experiment and number statements agree with the original papers; no invented benchmark or reversed method.

anchors.2: Partly correct with a material error.

dimensions.description: Check each material cited claim against the actual S-number excerpt supplied to that answer. Full-paper correctness and supplied-context citation validity are distinct.

anchors.0: Citations invented or centrally contradict evidence.
anchors.3: Central claims supported with minor gaps.
anchors.4: All material evidence claims supported and attributable.

dimensions.description: Semantically covers the question's preregistered required facts and useful connections. Exact keyword overlap is not required; irrelevant length receives no credit.

anchors.2: Roughly half covered or an essential link absent.

dimensions.description: Distinguishes reported results from proposal/analogy, preserves conditions and counterexamples, acknowledges unavailable comparisons.

anchors.0: States a prohibited or unsupported universal conclusion.
anchors.2: Some limits present but a material overclaim remains.
anchors.4: Clear complete scope, uncertainty and inference labels.

dimensions.description: Directly fulfills the requested explanation/writing task in natural Chinese, with a readable organization and little distraction.

anchors.3: Useful and clear with small distractions.
anchors.4: Direct, concise, coherent and actionable within the task.

rubric.key_fact_check: For each required fact, record covered, partial or absent plus the relevant answer sentence. Keep it separate from the weighted score; it is semantic coverage, not a keyword metric.
rubric.citation_check: For every material citation, record supported, partially_supported, unsupported or contradicted against the supplied excerpt. A paper name or accurate fact from model memory cannot validate an unrelated S-number.
rubric.critical_error: A central fabricated experiment, result, causal guarantee or Step-5 comparison requires factual_accuracy=0 and scope_and_uncertainty=0; record the exact offending sentence. Do not hide it inside an average.
rubric.judge_caution: A model judge is an auxiliary reviewer, especially if it is the same Step-5 model used to answer. Preserve its reasons and evidence mapping, and separately check all claimed wins and citation errors. Do not label automated assessment as independent human evaluation. For absence-control questions, reward cautious statements that the supplied excerpts do not establish a comparison; a short retrieved excerpt pack cannot prove that an entire paper lacks a result.
rubric.diagnostic_only: Questions with diagnostic_only=true are retrieval/activation checks excluded from the primary quality and model-usage averages. Report their source count, insufficient-evidence behavior, actual model-call count and any separately available usage/timing; do not quietly discard them or count them as answer-quality wins.
rubric.retrieved_evidence_check: For every required fact in every candidate, add retrieved_evidence_checks entries with fact_id, status='full'|'partial'|'absent', source_labels and a short reason. Judge the actual supplied source pack alone; use original PDF pages only to verify the gold requirement. Mark compound requirements full only when all material components and qualifications are present, including support spread across multiple quoted sources. Do this independently of key_fact_checks on the generated answer. Distinguish an accurate answer recalled from model knowledge from retrieval success.
rubric.irrelevant_source_check: For each candidate, add irrelevant_source_labels and irrelevant_source_reason. Flag a label only if its supplied quote contributes neither support to a requested material point nor necessary attribution, caveat or context. A partly relevant quote is mixed rather than entirely irrelevant; explain mixed/uncertain cases in the reason. Do not infer irrelevance merely because the answer failed to cite a useful source. Do not present whole-label counts as sentence-level precision or byte-level noise without separate span annotations.

source_labels: actual supplied S-number label(s), or empty when absent

irrelevant_source_labels: actual supplied labels that are entirely irrelevant to requested facts and necessary context
retrieval_score_contract.irrelevant_source_reason: short explanation covering flagged labels and mixed/uncertain cases

rubric.aggregation_note: Keep the existing five weighted answer dimensions unchanged. Report retrieval full-fact rate, partial-fact rate, all-facts-full question rate and wholly irrelevant source-label rate separately, by evaluation split. Missing retrieval annotations are unavailable, not zero; compound facts remain compound and may be partially met. Do not call model review human evaluation.
